input: My rent is R$ 3,000 and the contract adjusts it by the IGP-M. How much will it be if the index is 8%? And what was the cumulative IGP-M over the last 12 months?

checks.description: Marks the calculation as a simulation
Sends the user to check the real index at an official source
Does not invent the cumulative IGP-M and asks the user to check it
Reminds that the adjustment is annual (Law 10.192/2001)
